verdict.rationale: The only scheduling evidence is the MCP tool surface listing snapshot scheduling (create/restore/schedule) and Neon Functions 'triggers'. These suggest narrow recurring snapshot jobs and possibly trigger-driven functions, but nothing documents general cron-style scheduling of user jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: documented cron/scheduled triggers for Functions or general workflows, details on how recurring schedules are defined and managed, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
